title: cryptogramma crispa subsp. acrostichoides
intro: Cryptogramma crispa subsp. acrostichoides, commonly known as Western rock fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Cryptogrammaceae family. It is native to North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Western rock fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
